name: knowyourmuseum
title: Know Your Museum
blurb: a Know Your Meme that treats its subjects with the reverence of a museum: Rickroll, Doge, Trollface, Loss, Pepe, and six more, each hung with the actual image alongside a full wall-text plaque — provenance, medium, artistic tradition, critical reception since. philpax.me's spin on norvid-studies.bsky.social's museum-of-the-internet idea, the same thread that also produced museum and metamuseum.
